slug.name: China Sourcing Expo – LATAM Buyers Edition

en.name: China Sourcing Expo – LATAM Buyers Edition
en.description: Curated factory tours and sourcing sessions for LATAM importers diversifying supply chains from Guangdong.
en.metaTitle: China Sourcing Expo – LATAM Buyers Edition | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Curated factory tours and sourcing sessions for LATAM importers diversifying supply chains from Guangdong. Shenzhen, 22–24 January 2026.
en.overviewHtml: A buyer-focused edition of the sourcing expo, built around factory tours and pre-vetted supplier meetings in Guangdong's manufacturing belt.
en.whoShouldAttendHtml: LATAM importers and retail buyers diversifying supply chains; category managers for home goods, electronics accessories, and packaging.
en.formatHtml: Guided factory tours, one-on-one sourcing meetings, and an interpreter desk for every delegation.

br.name: China Sourcing Expo – Edicao Compradores LATAM
br.description: Visitas curadas a fabricas e sessoes de sourcing para importadores latino-americanos diversificando cadeias de suprimento em Guangdong.
br.metaTitle: China Sourcing Expo – Edicao Compradores LATAM | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Visitas curadas a fabricas e sessoes de sourcing para importadores latino-americanos diversificando cadeias de suprimento em Guangdong. Em Shenzhen, 22–24 de janeiro de 2026.
br.overviewHtml: Uma edicao voltada a compradores, estruturada em torno de visitas a fabricas e reunioes com fornecedores pre-avaliados no cinturao industrial de Guangdong.
br.whoShouldAttendHtml: Importadores e compradores varejistas da America Latina que buscam diversificar cadeias de suprimento; gestores de categoria de bens para o lar, acessorios eletronicos e embalagens.
br.formatHtml: Visitas guiadas a fabricas, reunioes individuais de sourcing e um balcao de intepretacao para cada delegacao.

cn.name: 中国采购博览会–拉丁美洲采购商专场
cn.description: 为拉丁美洲进口商量身定制工厂参观与采购对接，帮助其在广东实现供应链多元化。
cn.metaTitle: 中国采购博览会–拉丁美洲采购商专场 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 2026年1月22–24日，深圳，为拉丁美洲进口商量身定制工厂参观与采购对接，帮助其在广东实现供应链多元化。
cn.overviewHtml: 本届博览会以采购商为中心，围绕广东制造业带的工厂参观与预先筛选的供应商会面展开。
cn.whoShouldAttendHtml: 寻求供应链多元化的拉丁美洲进口商与零售采购商；家居、电子配件及包装品类的品类经理。
cn.formatHtml: 包含引导式工厂参观、一对一采购会谈，并为每个代表团配备翻译服务台。
